@title AegisAnchor
 @notice Basic contract to verify Solidity compilation in our infrastructure.

@title ExecutionManager
 @notice Manages approvals, execution triggers, and status tracking for strategy updates.
@notice Initiates a pending execution state for a strategy ID.
@notice Modifies the current execution state (e.g. Approved, Executed, Cancelled).
@notice Returns the total count of strategy execution events.

@title StrategyRegistry
 @notice Stores generated portfolio rebalancing strategies and recommendations.
@notice Registers a new strategy recommendation generated by the enclave.
@notice Returns the total count of registered strategies.
